issue.title: standalone tunnel route is missing after config reload

failure.body:
## issue description
As the title, after config reload, the standalone tunnel routes could not be restored.

## analysis
From the syslog:
```
66338:Feb 22 <IPV6>.674642 INFO swss#orchagent: :- addZeroMacTunnelRoute: Creating tunnel route for neighbor <IP>
...
67269:Feb 22 <IPV6>.080393 NOTICE swss#orchagent: :- handleMuxCfg: Ethernet4: <IP> was added to ignored neighbor list
67270:Feb 22 <IPV6>.080435 INFO swss#orchagent: :- handleMuxCfg: Mux Peer switch addr not yet configured, port 'Ethernet4'
```
At the time `NeighOrch` calls `addZeroMacTunnelRoute` to let `muxorch` update zero mac neighbor, the `MuxCable` object for `Ethernet4` is not created yet, so the event is ignored:
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/f66abeda6a6e67b40b997b779ec3a6a362632fc1/orchagent/neighorch.cpp#L1758-L1765
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/f66abeda6a6e67b40b997b779ec3a6a362632fc1/orchagent/muxorch.cpp#L1100-L1105

But in `addZeroMacTunnelRoute`, `NeighOrch` caches this zero-mac neighbor, for any following zero-mac neighbor events, `NeighOrch` will believe that `MuxOrch` has already install the standalone tunnel route and ignore those events.
https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-swss/blob/f66abeda6a6e67b40b997b779ec3a6a362632fc1/orchagent/neighorch.cpp#L742-L753

resolution.title: [dualtor] Fix neighbor miss when mux is not ready
resolution.description:
**What I did**
The issue is that `MuxOrch::m_syncdNeighbors` assumes all cached zero-mac neighbors have tunnel routes installed. The check before adding tunnel routes ignores the following zero-mac neighbor events.
Let's ensure that, if a zero-mac neighbor is present in `MuxOrch::m_syncdNeighbors`, it has a tunnel route installed.
So let's check the tunnel route install success before adding a neighbor to `MuxOrch::m_syncdNeighbors`.

**Why I did it**
To fix #2675
If `MuxOrch` is not fully initialized, and there is a `FAILED` neighbor added to kernel, the tunnel route creation will fail. But the subsequent `FAILED` neighbor events cannot trigger tunnel route creation because `MuxOrch::m_syncdNeighbors` caches the first event and regard the tunnel as already installed.

**How I verified it**
UT and verify on testbed.

**Details if related**
